solutions.title: Recursive mirror check
solutions.strategy: Compare paired mirror nodes and recurse into outside and inside children.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node participates in at most one mirror comparison.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack is bounded by tree height h.

solutions.title: Iterative mirror queue
solutions.strategy: Process mirror node pairs from a queue and enqueue outside and inside pairs.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node pair is checked once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can store a level of mirror pairs.
